label: Creator Mix
line: Two reels in one: a creator studio edit and a motion edit. Colour-world backgrounds, whip and shatter cuts, number posters, photo strips. Meta Muse Spark directs.
ref: Tahrima (instagram.com/reel/DaFaIEGIFvx) + a real estate motion reel
fundamentals: full frame talking head; 8 to 16 effects picked by what is said and reused when the clip is long; one accent colour family per video; the room replaced by moving colour worlds behind the speaker; whip, radial, invert, tilt and shatter transitions; highlighter phrases, bokeh glow words, number posters, vertical photo strips; before/after with a visible 'Edited by Meta' line
